tool.name: Tabular Learner
tool.description: applies and evaluates multiple machine learning models on a tabular dataset
tool.command: python $__tool_directory__/pycaret_train.py --input_file '$data_configuration.input_file' --target_col '$data_configuration.target_feature' --output_dir '.' --random_seed '$customize_defaults_section.random_seed' --n-jobs \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} #if $data_configuration.sample_id_selector.use_sample_id == "yes" --sample-id-column '$data_configuration.sample_id_selector.sample_id_column' #end if #if $model_hyperparameter_configuration.model_selection.model_type == "classification" #if $model_hyperparameter_configuration.model_selection.classification_models --models '$model_hyperparameter_configuration.model_selection.classification_models' #end if #end if #if $model_hyperparameter_configuration.model_selection.model_type == "regression" #if $model_hyperparameter_configuration.model_selection.regression_models --models '$model_hyperparameter_configuration.model_selection.regression_models' #end if #end if #if $model_hyperparameter_configuration.tune_model --tune_model #end if #if $customize_defaults_section.train_size --train_size '$customize_defaults_section.train_size' #end if #if $customize_defaults_section.normalize --normalize #end if #if $customize_defaults_section.feature_selection --feature_selection #end if #if $customize_defaults_section.cross_validation.enable_cross_validation == "true" --cross_validation #if $customize_defaults_section.cross_validation.cross_validation_folds --cross_validation_folds '$customize_defaults_section.cross_validation.cross_validation_folds' #end if #end if #if $customize_defaults_section.cross_validation.enable_cross_validation == "false" --no_cross_validation #end if #if $customize_defaults_section.remove_outliers --remove_outliers #end if #if $customize_defaults_section.remove_multicollinearity --remove_multicollinearity #end if #if $customize_defaults_section.polynomial_features --polynomial_features #end if #if $customize_defaults_section.fix_imbalance --fix_imbalance #end if #if $customize_defaults_section.probability_threshold --probability_threshold '$customize_defaults_section.probability_threshold' #end if #if $data_configuration.test_data_choice.has_test_file == "yes" --test_file '$data_configuration.test_data_choice.test_file' #end if --model_type '$model_hyperparameter_configuration.model_selection.model_type' #if $model_hyperparameter_configuration.model_selection.best_model_metric --best_model_metric '$model_hyperparameter_configuration.model_selection.best_model_metric' #end if

param.name: test_file
param.label: Test dataset
param.help: If a test dataset is provided, the training dataset is used as the training/CV pool and the test dataset is used for final test metrics. If no test dataset is provided, Train Size controls the train/test split. When cross-validation is enabled, validation metrics use out-of-fold predictions from the training/CV pool.

param.name: use_sample_id
param.label: Use a sample ID column for leakage-aware splitting?
param.help: Select yes to choose a column that groups related records (e.g., patient_id or slide_id).

param.name: sample_id_column
param.label: Sample ID column
param.help: All rows with the same ID stay in the same split to reduce leakage. Used for group-aware splitting when no separate test file is provided, and for group-aware cross-validation when enabled.

param.name: classification_models
param.label: Candidate classification models
param.help: Leave blank to compare all supported classification models.

param.name: best_model_metric
param.label: Metric used to pick the best model
param.help: PyCaret will rank models by this metric. Default is Accuracy.

param.name: regression_models
param.label: Candidate regression models
param.help: Leave blank to compare all supported regression models.

param.name: best_model_metric
param.label: Metric used to pick the best model
param.help: PyCaret will rank models by this metric. Default is R².

param.name: tune_model
param.label: Tune hyperparameters
param.help: Hyperparameter tuning on the best model

param.name: train_size
param.label: Train Size
param.help: Proportion of the input dataset to include in the train split.

param.name: normalize
param.label: Normalize Data
param.help: Whether to normalize data before training.

param.name: enable_cross_validation
param.label: Enable Cross Validation?
param.help: Enabled by default. When enabled, PyCaret ranks candidate models with cross-validation and the report shows final Validation metrics from out-of-fold predictions. Select No to use PyCaret holdout ranking and omit the final Validation column.

param.name: cross_validation_folds
param.label: Cross Validation Folds
param.help: Number of folds to use for cross-validation. Default is 10.

param.name: remove_outliers
param.label: Remove Outliers
param.help: Whether to remove outliers from the input dataset before training.

param.name: remove_multicollinearity
param.label: Remove Multicollinearity
param.help: Whether to remove multicollinear features before training.

param.name: polynomial_features
param.label: Polynomial Features
param.help: Whether to create polynomial features before training.

param.name: fix_imbalance
param.label: Fix Imbalance
param.help: ONLY for classfication! Whether to use SMOTE or similar methods to fix imbalance in the input dataset.

param.name: probability_threshold
param.label: Classification Probability Threshold
param.help: Only applies to classification. Probability above which a prediction is considered positive. Default is 0.5.

tool.help:
This tool uses PyCaret to train and evaluate machine learning models. It compares different models on a dataset and provides the best model based on the performance metrics. You can optionally select a sample ID column to keep related records in the same split and reduce data leakage when the tool creates splits internally.
**Outputs**
- **Model**: The best model trained on the dataset in h5 format.
- **Comparison Result**: The comparison result of different models in html format. It contains the performance metrics of different models, plots of the best model on the testing set (or part of the training set if a separate test set is not uploaded), and feature analysis plots.
